en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large star‑fort style fortress with high brick ramparts covered in grass and dry moats in the foreground. Behind the fortifications stand long, simple barracks‑like buildings with many windows and gabled roofs, and a single church tower with a Baroque‑style spire rises among them. Low mountains or hills appear faintly in the distant background. The overall look suggests an old European military fortress complex.
